titleEn: Two Bathroom Renovation Cost in Burnaby 2026: Real Project Data for Families Doing Both Bathrooms
titleZh: 本拿比双浴室装修费用2026：家庭双浴室同时装修真实工程数据
contentEn:
A two-bathroom renovation for a family in Burnaby costs $28,000 to $75,000 in 2026, depending on whether the scope is a cosmetic refresh of both bathrooms or a full re-plumb of each. Reno Stars completed a two-bathroom renovation for a family in a Burnaby townhouse in 2025 where both bathrooms received a complete overhaul — new prefabricated vanities, custom glass shower doors, quartz countertops, replaced bathtubs, updated plumbing and electrical, and optimized lighting — at a total cost comparable to the $40,000 to $55,000 range for this scope in Metro Vancouver.

Why families in Burnaby choose to do both bathrooms at once

Doing two bathrooms simultaneously costs more upfront but typically costs 20 to 35 percent less than doing them separately over time. The cost savings come from a single contractor mobilization, a single permit application, combined plumbing and electrical work scheduled together, and a single trade coordination window. For a family living in the home during renovation, doing both bathrooms at once also means only one period of disruption rather than two separate renovation cycles — each of which in a family home requires the same setup and cleanup effort. The tradeoff is a higher动员 cost and more rooms to manage simultaneously, which is why working with a general contractor who coordinates all trades matters more on a two-bathroom project than on a single-bathroom renovation.

What does a two-bathroom renovation cost in Burnaby in 2026

Costs fall into three tiers based on scope and material selection:

  • Both bathrooms — cosmetic refresh: New vanities, faucets, toilets, lighting, paint and flooring in both bathrooms. No plumbing relocation. $28,000 to $40,000. Typical timeline: 3 to 5 weeks. Permit not required unless toilet is relocated.
  • Both bathrooms — full renovation with shower replacement: Remove and replace bathtubs with new shower enclosures, custom glass doors, quartz countertops, new tile, updated plumbing and electrical, new lighting. $40,000 to $55,000. Typical timeline: 6 to 9 weeks. Building permit required for shower pan and drain work.
  • Both bathrooms — re-plumb to the studs with layout change: Demo to the studs in both bathrooms, reroute drain lines and water supply, new subfloor, full tile, custom glass enclosures, custom vanity millwork, new plumbing fixtures throughout. $55,000 to $75,000+. Typical timeline: 10 to 16 weeks. Full building permit required.

What materials and finishes add the most cost in a two-bathroom renovation

Custom glass shower doors are the single largest finish upgrade in a family bathroom renovation in Burnaby. A single frameless or semi-frameless glass panel with chrome or matte-black hardware runs $800 to $2,200 per door installed. A two-bathroom project with custom glass in each bathroom typically adds $1,600 to $4,400 to the budget for glass alone. Quartz countertops for two bathrooms — typically a double-sink main bathroom and a single-sink second bathroom — run $1,200 to $3,000 installed depending on square footage and edge profile. Pre-fabricated vanities from a supplier like Tactile or Rubi come in at $400 to $1,200 each; custom millwork vanities run $1,200 to $3,500 per unit. The choice between pre-fab and custom millwork is the second-largest cost variable after the plumbing scope.

How long does a two-bathroom renovation take in Burnaby

A cosmetic two-bathroom refresh in Burnaby takes 3 to 5 weeks from material selection to handover. A full renovation with shower replacements takes 6 to 9 weeks. A re-plumb to the studs with layout changes takes 10 to 16 weeks. The City of Burnaby's residential building permit queue for bathroom renovations was running 3 to 5 weeks as of mid-2026 for standard renovation permits. A two-bathroom renovation permit application that covers both bathrooms in a single application is processed faster than two separate single-bathroom applications, because the inspector reviews one file rather than two.

FAQ: Two Bathroom Renovation Cost in Burnaby

Is it cheaper to do two bathrooms at once or separately?

Doing two bathrooms at once is typically 20 to 35 percent cheaper per bathroom than doing them separately over time. The savings come from a single contractor mobilization, one combined permit application, coordinated plumbing and electrical work, and one set of trade coordination. The tradeoff is a higher upfront cost and a more intensive project period.

What is the average cost of a two-bathroom renovation in Burnaby in 2026?

A two-bathroom cosmetic refresh in Burnaby costs $28,000 to $40,000 in 2026. A full renovation with new shower enclosures, custom glass doors and quartz countertops costs $40,000 to $55,000. A re-plumb to the studs with layout changes costs $55,000 to $75,000 or more.

Does a two-bathroom renovation in Burnaby require two permits?

Both bathrooms can be covered under a single building permit application in Burnaby if they are in the same unit. A single permit covering both bathrooms processes faster than two separate applications and costs less in total permit fees. Reno Stars manages the permit application as the general contractor.

How long does a two-bathroom renovation take in Burnaby?

A cosmetic two-bathroom refresh takes 3 to 5 weeks. A full renovation with shower replacements takes 6 to 9 weeks. A re-plumb to the studs takes 10 to 16 weeks. The City of Burnaby's residential bathroom permit queue was running 3 to 5 weeks as of mid-2026.

What is the biggest cost variable in a two-bathroom renovation?

Custom glass shower doors are typically the largest finish upgrade, adding $800 to $2,200 per door installed. Two custom glass doors in a two-bathroom project add $1,600 to $4,400 to the budget. Custom millwork vanities versus pre-fabricated vanities are the second-largest variable, adding $800 to $2,300 per unit for custom over pre-fab.

本拿比家庭双浴室装修在2026年的费用为28,000至75,000加元，具体取决于两间浴室是基础翻新还是水管全面重铺。聚星裝修于2025年在本拿比城市屋完成了一个家庭双浴室装修项目，两间浴室均接受全面翻新——新预制浴室柜、定制玻璃淋浴门、石英石台面、更换浴缸、优化照明、更新管道和电气系统——总价相当于大温地区同等工程范围的40,000至55,000加元区间。

为什么本拿比家庭选择同时装修两间浴室

双浴室同时装修前期投入更高，但通常比分开两次装修节省20%至35%的费用。节省来自：单次施工动员、单次许可证申请、合并的管道和电气工程统筹安排、以及单次协调窗口。对于在装修期间仍需居住在内的家庭，同时装修两间浴室意味着只有一段干扰期，而非两次独立的装修周期——每次在家庭住宅中都需要相同的准备和清理工作。代价是更高的动员成本和更紧张的施工期管理，这也是为什么在双浴室项目中，选择协调所有工种的总承包商比单浴室项目更为关键。

2026年本拿比双浴室装修费用明细

费用按工程范围和材料选择分三个档次：

  • 两间浴室——基础翻新：两间浴室新浴室柜、水龙头、马桶、照明、油漆和地板。无管道移位。28,000至40,000加元。典型工期：3至5周。除非马桶移位，否则无需许可证。
  • 两间浴室——含淋浴间更换的全面装修：拆除并更换两间浴室的浴缸为新淋浴间、定制玻璃门、石英石台面、新瓷砖、更新管道和电气、新照明。40,000至55,000加元。典型工期：6至9周。淋浴盘和排水工程需建筑许可证。
  • 两间浴室——含布局改造的水管重铺至基层：两间浴室均开敞至基层装修，重铺排水管和供水管线、新地板基层、全屋瓷砖、定制玻璃隔断、定制木制品浴室柜、全套管道装置。55,000至75,000加元以上。典型工期：10至16周。需要全面建筑许可证。

双浴室装修中哪些材料和饰面增加最多成本

定制玻璃淋浴门是本拿比家庭浴室装修中单项最大的饰面升级。单扇无框或半无框玻璃面板配镀铬或哑光黑五金，含安装每扇800至2,200加元。双浴室项目两间各装一扇，玻璃费用增加1,600至4,400加元。两间浴室石英石台面——通常主浴室双池和次浴室单池——含安装根据面积和边缘造型，费用1,200至3,000加元。供应商提供的预制浴室柜（如Tactile或Rubi）每个400至1,200加元；定制木制品浴室柜每个1,200至3,500加元。预制与定制木制品之间的选择是继管道工程范围之后第二大成本变量。

本拿比双浴室装修需要多长时间

本拿比双浴室基础翻新从材料选定到交付约需3至5周。含淋浴间更换的全面装修约需6至9周。含布局改造的水管重铺至基层约需10至16周。截至2026年年中，本拿比市民用建筑许可证浴室装修队列，标准装修许可证约3至5周。一个覆盖两间浴室的双浴室装修许可证申请比两次单独单浴室申请处理更快，因为检查员只需审查一份档案而非两份。

FAQ：本拿比双浴室装修费用

双浴室同时装修还是分开装修更划算？

双浴室同时装修通常比分开两次装修每间浴室节省20%至35%的费用。节省来自单次施工动员、单次合并许可证申请、协调的管道和电气工程以及单次工种协调。代价是更高的前期投入和更紧张的施工期。

2026年本拿比双浴室装修平均费用是多少？

本拿比双浴室基础翻新在2026年费用为28,000至40,000加元。含新淋浴间、定制玻璃门和石英石台面的全面装修费用为40,000至55,000加元。水管重铺至基层含布局改造费用为55,000至75,000加元以上。

本拿比双浴室装修需要两个许可证吗？

如果两间浴室在同一单元，可在同一建筑许可证申请下覆盖。涵盖两间浴室的单次许可证比两次单独申请处理更快，总费用更低。聚星裝修作为总承包商代理管理许可证申请。

本拿比双浴室装修需要多长时间？

双浴室基础翻新约3至5周。含淋浴间更换的全面装修约6至9周。水管重铺至基层约10至16周。截至2026年年中，本拿比市民用浴室许可证队列约3至5周。

双浴室装修中最大的成本变量是什么？

定制玻璃淋浴门通常是最大的单项饰面升级，每扇门含安装800至2,200加元。双浴室项目两扇定制玻璃门增加1,600至4,400加元预算。定制木制品浴室柜与预制浴室柜的差异是第二大变量，每单元定制比预制多800至2,300加元。
